programme.desc: 'S7/E40 - Vianey & Allen's Story Part 2'. At over 600-lbs each, Vianey and Allen are in a co-dependent relationship based on a shared love of food. Can they conquer their addiction together?

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: 'S7/E4 - Emotions And Pregnancy'. Mia's baby shower is upended when her mum arrives late. Mama G pushes Jose to prove he can provide. Bella and Hunter's growing strain erupts.

programme.desc: 'S3/E9 - Hot Mom Summer'. Sunhe grills Jason's mum about her lack of contact with Angelica and Amara. Plus, Amy's realisations about Kai impact her relationship with Carina.

programme.desc: 'S3/E10 - Between A Mom And A Hard Place'. Lauren finds out the results of the IUI, while Jared returns to Florida to confront Dawn and Cher. Angelica questions Jason about his commitment.

programme.desc: 'S4/E1 - We Are One'. Mum Francia and daughter Paula love to cook naked together. Plus, Angie teaches her newly transitioned daughter, Shay, to shave her legs.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: In this action-packed movie shot in South Africa, Idris Elba fights for his family's survival as a rogue lion hunts a father and his teenage daughters.

programme.title: The Fast And The Furious
programme.desc: Vin Diesel and the late Paul Walker team up for the first instalment of the popular franchise, which sees a cop go undercover to infiltrate a racing crew.

programme.title: Asphalt City
programme.desc: An intense medical thriller starring Sean Penn. A young paramedic is paired with a seasoned partner on the night shift in New York, revealing a city in crisis.

programme.title: Escape The Field
programme.desc: There is no way out in this gripping survival thriller. Six strangers wake up in a cornfield to find they are thrust into a deadly cat-and-mouse game with something mysterious.

programme.title: Four Good Days
programme.desc: In this touching true-life-inspired story, Glenn Close portrays a mother trying to help her drug-addicted daughter (Mila Kunis). They have four crucial days of recovery ahead of them.

programme.title: Spud 3: Learning To Fly
programme.desc: The third instalment of the South African tale follows a now sixteen-year-old Spud Milton (Troye Sivan) who must navigate the difficulties of being a senior at boarding school.

programme.title: Minions: The Rise Of Gru
programme.desc: A side-splitting prequel to the smash-hit animated franchise. The untold story of one twelve-year-old's dream to become the world's greatest supervillain.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: A touching and inspiring biopic focused on the life of a prominent US freedom fighter. Harriet Tubman escapes slavery and devotes her life to abolishing the practice.

programme.title: Something New
programme.desc: Looking for an at-home date movie? Simon Baker (The Mentalist) stars in this feel-good romp about interracial romance and following your heart to love.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy learns why silence is golden in this hilarious comedy. A fast-talking agent must watch his every word after a spiritual guru attempts to teach him a valuable lesson.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman and Tommy Lee Jones star in this enjoyable action-comedy. An ex FBI Agent and ex-mob lawyer are forced to put aside their differences to fend off a potential mob hit.

programme.title: Khumba
programme.desc: A proudly South African animation with the voice talents of Liam Neeson and Laurence Fishburne. A half-striped zebra embarks on an inspirational journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Dogtanian And The Three Muskehounds
programme.desc: A canine remake of a 1980s cartoon. Dogtanian goes to Paris to join the Muskehounds, and when the evil Richelieu plots to seize power, he and the trio must defend the King.

programme.title: Arthur The King
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg stars in this heartwarming tale. An adventure racing team befriends a stray dog while competing in an endurance race in the Dominican Republic.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Denzel Washington and Ryan Reynolds must survive the streets of Cape Town in this high energy action film. After a safe house is attacked, a CIA agent must protect his charge.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: An old-fashioned woman rejects every marriage proposal while waiting for the perfect match. When pressure mounts, she takes matters into her own hands to find the one.

programme.title: Simulant
programme.desc: A thought-provoking sci-fi thriller set in the near future. A humanoid sparks an AI uprising after enlisting a global hacker to remove all restrictions on his thoughts and capabilities.

programme.title: Let Him Go
programme.desc: A star-studded cast leads this book-inspired 1960s Western thriller. A grieving couple tries to reclaim their only grandson, but things quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Operation Mincemeat
programme.desc: John Madden brings to life a remarkable true story that shows that all is fair in war. Two British intelligence officers devise a deceptive plan to outwit German troops during WWII.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Gore Verbinski and Johnny Depp (The Pirates of the Caribbean) create an amazing, action-filled animation. A chameleon stuck in a lawless western town becomes its reluctant hero.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: The late Garry Marshall directs an ensemble cast in this holiday comedy. Three generations come together in the week leading up to Mother's Day.

programme.title: Couples Retreat
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn and Jon Favreau write and star in this film about marriage. Four couples and a holiday resort are brought face-to-face with the problems in their relationships.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Greg has to prove himself to his father-in-law Jack once more, as he tries to juggle two jobs and two kids.

programme.title: The Croods: A New Age
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns for another prehistoric adventure. This time, the Croods are challenged by a rival family, the Bettermans, who claim to be better and more evolved.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Everyone's favourite ogre returns for another adventure. Newlyweds Fiona and Shrek are invited to visit Fiona's parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: The demigod son of Zeus must leave his peaceful life behind and become a warrior again when his father is kidnapped. He enlists the help of a warrior queen to face Zeus's captors.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: Mel Gibson plays a fearless bomb expert in this cyber-thriller. An ex-hacker is forced to break into high-level banking institutions while having a bomb strapped to his chair.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Fans of Twister will be taken by this danger-filled storm movie. A teenage boy runs away to follow in his father's footsteps, legendary storm chaser Bill Brody.

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: This action thriller finds Liam Neeson and Aidan Quinn on opposite sides of the law. A government operative finds himself in the crosshairs of a man he once helped protect.

programme.title: Bulletproof
programme.desc: Adam Sandler proves his versatility in this buddy action comedy that sees a small-time thief forced to team up with a cop that once betrayed him, played by Damon Wayans.
